answer.title: Automated Friday Timesheet Reminder
answer.trigger: Every Friday at 13:45, check the payroll system for unsubmitted timesheets.
steps: Run a scheduled check in the payroll system to identify who has not submitted their timesheet.
Filter the list of employees with missing timesheets.
Draft a friendly reminder email for each employee who has not yet submitted.
Send the reminder email automatically to the respective staff members.
answer.ai_help: Drafting personalized reminder emails based on the employee names and missing status.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, employees might receive an unnecessary reminder email.
